newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market turnover 394.3 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market turnover 394.3 bln yuan.

text.p: Turnover on China's renminbi interbank market was 394.34 billion yuan in the first nine months of operation, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.
From January to September, average daily turnover was 2.09 billion yuan, the newspaper said. Turnover on the market rose steadily in the first nine months while interest rates fell slightly, it said.

Provincial short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, were the most active traders on the market, accounting for 70 percent of total turnover in the period, it said.

State banks were less active, with their trading accounting for only 19 percent, the newspaper said. The rest of trading came from non-bank financial institutions, including securities houses and brokerages, it said.
Institutions from Shanghai, Beijing and the northeast province of Liaoning were the most active.

Seven-day and 60-day contracts were the most active contracts in the nine months, and one-day and 20-day contracts the least active, the newspaper said. The highest rate was 16.92 percent and the lowest 8.82 percent.
